22 Indian sailors rescued after tanker hit by drone off UAE coast

Twenty-two Indian sailors were rescued after a drone attack set a Panama-flagged tanker ablaze off the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. The incident occurred at sea, and all crew members were safely brought back.
